criteria_verification.notes: Independent test execution confirms test_happy_path_returns_voice_turn_result passed. Orchestrator verified the full flow: parse → transcribe → SessionService.turn() (persists two rows) → synthesize → ChunkStore → return VoiceTurnResult with transcript, tutor_response, and one AudioRef.

Four independent tests passed covering all error paths: (1) test_rejection_precedes_stt verifies validation rejects with STT call count = 0, (2) test_unintelligible_query_when_transcript_empty verifies no turn on empty transcript, (3) test_stt_unavailable_propagates_before_turn verifies no turn on STT failure, (4) test_assum_005_tts_failure_after_turn_returns_text_only verifies TTS failure after turn returns text-only with audio=[] and turn recorded once.

Eight ChunkStore tests independently verified: TTL expiry on get and put operations, oldest-first eviction at max_entries cap, session isolation (wrong session returns None), unguessable chunk_ids via secrets.token_urlsafe(16), plus asyncio lock for race prevention.

Independent test test_no_audio_bytes_in_logs passed using caplog fixture to verify no audio bytes appear in logs. Code inspection confirms ChunkStore uses in-memory dict only (no disk/DB writes), and implementation discards audio bytes immediately after transcription per code comment.
